install.command: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf -L -o /tmp/nix-installer "https://install.determinate.systems/nix/tag/v3.22.3/nix-installer-$(uname -m)-linux" && chmod +x /tmp/nix-installer && /tmp/nix-installer install linux --no-confirm && rm -f /tmp/nix-installer && sudo ln -sf /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/* /usr/local/bin/

prepare.command: if [ -d /home/user/.nix-profile/bin ]; then for f in /home/user/.nix-profile/bin/*; do if [ -e "$f" ] && [ ! -e "/usr/local/bin/$(basename "$f")" ]; then sudo ln -s "$f" /usr/local/bin/; fi; done; fi
